messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High GPU queue growth detected for prod-inference-pool. Autoscaler not launching new nodes. Severity: P1. Please acknowledge.

maria: ack oncall here, looking now. which pool?

raj: seeing the alert: queue length ~ 18k, latency spikes, tokens piling. HPA events show "no metrics returned" for the custom metric `inference_queue_length`.

erin: confirming HPA error from `kubectl describe hpa inference-svc`:
```
Events:
  Type    Reason              Age   From                       Message
  ----    ------              ----  ----                       -------
  Warning  FailedGetMetrics   2m    horizontal-pod-autoscaler  failed to get metrics for resource/custom.metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1: no metrics returned from custom metrics API
```

raj: prometheus-adapter logs have repeated errors, snippet: 
```
E0305 14:02:21.123 1 adapter.go:214] error querying Prometheus: context deadline exceeded
E0305 14:02:22.456 1 queue.go:98] enqueue failed, dropping metric request, backlog=15342
```

maria: ok — looks like custom metrics pipeline is overloaded / timing out. can we restart prometheus-adapter or scale it?

sre-lead: plan: (1) manual short-term mitigation to stop customer impact (2) triage adapter + prometheus scrape backlog (3) root-cause and postmortem.

devops-bot: current prometheus-adapter replicas=2, pod restarts in last 5m: 6. Adapter CPU spiking.

maria: immediate actions: 1) flip routing for heavy customers to CPU-fallback pool; 2) temporarily scale inference deployment replicas up to absorb queue while autoscaler is broken; 3) attempt controlled restart of prometheus-adapter.

support-liaison: which customers impacted? I'm seeing elevated error rates for enterprise-xyz and beta-internal. I'll prep a short customer bulletin: "We are investigating higher latencies; no data loss; routing changes may affect latency but preserve availability."

raj: attempting a graceful restart of prometheus-adapter on prod: `kubectl rollout restart deployment prometheus-adapter -n monitoring`

erin: while that restarts, HPA won't get metrics. we should scale inference pools manually. suggestion: `kubectl scale deploy inference-gpu-pool -n prod --replicas=12` (was 6).

maria: executing manual scale now. will also open cloud console to request emergency GPU nodes if needed.

maria: ran: `kubectl scale deploy inference-gpu-pool -n prod --replicas=12` -> CLI returned ok. queue processing should start catching up as more pods pick up jobs.

devops-bot: prometheus-adapter pods are restarting. new pods still taking some time to warm up. backlog metric shows 14k -> 9k -> 4k (observed over ~6m).

raj: adapter logs after restart show improved connectivity but still hitting scrape timeouts for some label queries. increasing adapter replica count to 4 to help throughput: `kubectl scale deploy prometheus-adapter -n monitoring --replicas=4`

erin: HPA events now showing some successful scrapes but intermittent:
```
Normal  SuccessfulGetMetrics  30s  horizontal-pod-autoscaler  got metrics from custom.metrics.k8s.io: inference_queue_length=8000
Warning  FailedGetMetrics  5s  horizontal-pod-autoscaler  failed to get metrics: context deadline exceeded
```

maria: because of intermittent metrics we'll keep manual replicas while we validate autoscaler. also enabling routing fallback so new customer traffic avoids the GPU queue: `redwoodctl route update --from=prod --to=cpu-fallback --match=customer=enterprise-xyz --weight=1.0`

support-liaison: customer bulletin posted (internal + external): short note + link to status page. monitoring team will update every 15m.

product-ops: logging this as a partial degradation in status page: "Serving latency increased for some GPU-backed models; CPU fallback enabled for enterprise customers."

raj: metrics backlog now fully drained (observed backlog ~ 0). prometheus-adapter CPU normalized after scale to 4. HPA query success rate > 95% over last 2m.

erin: can we test HPA by scaling down replicas to force scale-up? propose: scale to 4 then wait to see HPA bring to target.

maria: doing test: `kubectl scale deploy inference-gpu-pool -n prod --replicas=4`

(devops-bot automated message): replica count changed -> 4.

raj: watching HPA, it detected metrics and initiated scale to 10 over 90s. events now: 
`Normal  SuccessfulRescale  30s  horizontal-pod-autoscaler  New size: 10; reason: metric inference_queue_length above target`

maria: autoscaler is now functional. manual replica guard removed: `kubectl scale deploy inference-gpu-pool -n prod --replicas=6` (default steady-state).

support-liaison: customers notified of resolution. no data loss, brief elevated latency window ~12m for affected customers.

sre-lead: summary: cause = prometheus-adapter overloaded / restart storm + scraping timeouts causing custom metrics API to fail -> HPA couldn't see queue metric -> autoscaler stalled -> queue growth -> GPU pool starvation.

sre-lead: mitigation taken: - manual scale to drain queue - restart & scale prometheus-adapter - enable CPU fallback routing - transient cloud GPU request queued but not required ultimately

maria: action items (assigned): - raj: follow up on adapter tuning and add circuit-breaker for adapter queue (prio P0) - devops: add HPA fallback rule (use resource metrics when custom metrics unavailable) - product-ops/support: customer comms summary for postmortem - postmortem to be drafted and linked to incident channel.

product-ops: I'll schedule postmortem meeting and set draft doc. aim to publish within 48h.

maria: thanks all. keeping channel open for 30m for any regression.

incident-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED by maria at 14:26Z. Follow-up: create postmortem and action-tracking ticket.
